limitations.host_free_energy: No independently computed empty-host F_host(alpha)-F_host(gamma) is present; approximately 67.9 kJ/formula unit is a calibrated scenario, not an independent prediction.
limitations.flexibility: All production and repeat RASPA calculations keep the framework rigid; no q-grid, spinodal, saddle, or barrier was sampled.
limitations.force_field: Framework LJ parameters are explicitly UFF-like placeholders; PACMOF charges are an electrostatic input, not a host free-energy model.
limitations.fugacity: Production inputs use FugacityCoefficient=1.0; PR/SRK corrections are post-processing sensitivities.
limitations.kinetics: Monte Carlo steps are not physical time; P_open/P_close hysteresis and rates are not identified by this dataset.
limitations.intermediate_structures: Only alpha and gamma ordered endpoints are available; no chemically validated intermediate X-pcu-5-Zn structures were supplied for a multi-rigid q-grid.
limitations.accessibility: The gamma/closed 19-bar long repeat has zero absolute loading and no constructed translation moves; treat this as an explicit accessibility/setup audit flag rather than a zero-uncertainty observation.
